name: Wither and Bloom

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/au/chapter-2-spells.  Artificer is omitted where listed because that class is not available in this game.

components.m: a withered vine twisted into a loop

summary: Creatures you choose (your foes) in a 10-foot-radius Sphere make a Constitution save: 3d6 Necrotic damage, half on a success; ordinary plants there wither. Then one creature you choose in the Sphere (the most hurt of your allies there) can spend one of its Hit Dice and regain Hit Points equal to the roll plus your spellcasting modifier. Each slot level above 2 adds 1d6 damage and one more Hit Die it can spend (the modifier is added once).
